items.docs: Search for places within a specified geographic area, optionally filtered by one or more place types. Results can be ranked by popularity or by distance from a center point.
Search for places using a free-form text query such as "spicy vegetarian food in Sydney". Returns a list of matching places ranked by relevance.
Return place and query predictions in response to partial text input. Supports session tokens so that autocomplete keystrokes plus a subsequent Place Details request are billed as a single session.

params.name: placeId
params.description: The unique place identifier returned by search or autocomplete.

params.name: languageCode
params.description: The language in which to return results (BCP-47 language tag).

params.name: regionCode
params.description: The region code, specified as a CLDR two-character region code.

items.docs: Retrieve comprehensive information about a specific place by its place ID, including address, location, opening hours, ratings, reviews, contact details, and photos.

params.name: photoName
params.description: The photo resource reference returned in a place's photos array (the segment following photos/).

params.name: maxHeightPx
params.description: Maximum desired height of the image in pixels (1-4800).

params.name: maxWidthPx
params.description: Maximum desired width of the image in pixels (1-4800).

params.name: skipHttpRedirect
params.description: If true, returns a JSON response with the photo URI instead of redirecting.

items.docs: Retrieve a photo for a place. The photo is referenced by the photo resource name returned in a Place Details, Nearby Search, or Text Search response. Returns the photo media or a redirect to the image bytes.
